paper.title: Asking Before Acting: Gather Information in Embodied Decision Making with Language Models
paper.central_claim: Asking Before Acting equips LLM embodied agents with an explicit information-gathering/questioning ability and finetuning to improve decision-making efficiency and success in unfamiliar or ambiguous environments, with simulated and real-world demonstrations.

signatures.operation: Planner reasons, chooses an environment action or natural-language question, appends returned answer to history and continues.
signatures.conditions: Helpful accessible question-answerer, correct answers, sufficient question/action budget, executable action semantics.
signatures.feedback: Oracle answers and environment transitions; not a sound semantic verifier.
signatures.selection_rule: not_applicable: no persistent improvement-admission mechanism; episode action choice only.
signatures.selection_data: ALFWorld ID/OOD and ambiguity/multiround tasks; arm randomized placements; human scenarios.
signatures.persistence: Within-episode history; no claim of growing reusable skills.
signatures.later_use: Next decision in the same task.
signatures.claimed_effect: Better partial-information and ambiguous-task success by explicitly gathering needed information.
signatures.failure_boundary: Oracle mistakes, repeated questions and assumptions; privileged captions/oracle limit transfer.

signatures.information: Rule/PDDL expert, ground truth and noisy expert trajectories; not a demonstrated frontier-agent generated teacher dataset.
signatures.operation: Convert trajectories to QA and imitation datasets; mask intentionally injected noisy actions; LoRA fine-tune Vicuna.
signatures.conditions: Expert coverage, useful noise distribution and QA labeling.
signatures.feedback: Supervised labels and training loss; interactive test trajectories evaluated afterward.
signatures.selection_rule: not_applicable: training optimization, not a persistent harness-selection loop.
signatures.selection_data: 1500 ambiguous and500 multiround training trajectories; exact unseen layout/ambiguity split follows supplied protocol, not independently audited.
signatures.persistence: Model parameters, distinct from fixed-model ABA-IC.
signatures.claimed_effect: More stable long-horizon asking than in-context examples alone.
signatures.failure_boundary: No demonstrated on-policy frontier harness distillation; noisy oracle remains; human physical execution not robot transfer.

gap.checked_gap: Explicit querying addresses partial observability; privileged answer availability is part of the solution, not eliminated uncertainty for free.
